channel.title: on Industrial Manufacturing Knowledge Base
channel.description: Open industrial manufacturing knowledge base: aluminum & magnesium die casting, CNC machining, injection molding, tooling, materials, automotive manufacturing and supplier selection. 50+ engineering articles and reference tables.

item.title: Aluminum Die Casting Process: Complete Engineering Guide
item.description: How aluminum die casting works end to end: cold chamber cycle, A380 and ADC12 alloys, shot parameters, die temperatures, tolerances and cost drivers.

item.title: Die Casting Cost Drivers: How Casting Prices Are Built
item.description: How die casting prices are built: alloy cost and gross-to-net yield, machine tonnage rate, cycle time, tooling amortisation, secondary operations and scrap.

item.title: Die Casting DFM: Wall Thickness, Draft Angles and Ribs
item.description: Die casting design rules: wall thickness limits, draft angles, rib and boss proportions, fillets, cored holes, NADCA tolerances and parting line planning.

item.title: Die Casting Gating and Runner Design Fundamentals
item.description: Gating and runner design for die casting: gate area calculation, gate velocity targets, tapered runners, overflow and vent sizing, PQ2 and fill simulation.

item.title: Die Casting Porosity: Causes, Detection and Prevention
item.description: Die casting porosity explained: gas versus shrinkage mechanisms, hydrogen, blistering, X-ray and CT detection, leak testing, impregnation and prevention.

item.title: Die Casting Shot Profile and Intensification Pressure
item.description: Shot profile design for die casting: slow shot wave control, sleeve fill ratio, changeover point, fast shot velocity, intensification timing and shot traces.

item.title: Die Casting Surface Defects: Troubleshooting Guide
item.description: Identify and correct die casting surface defects: cold shut, flow lines, soldering, blisters, flash, sink marks, drag marks and heat check veins on castings.

item.title: Die Casting Trimming, Deburring and Secondary Operations
item.description: Secondary operations for die castings: trim die design, degating, vibratory and blast deburring, impregnation, straightening, leak testing and machining.

item.title: Die Casting vs Sand Casting vs Gravity Casting Compared
item.description: Compare die casting, sand casting and gravity die casting on tolerance, wall thickness, mechanical properties, tooling cost, volume break-even and lead time.

item.title: Die Thermal Management: Cooling Lines and Die Temperature
item.description: Die thermal management for die casting: heat balance, cooling line sizing, jet cooling, temperature control units, spray strategy and heat checking control.

item.title: High Pressure Die Casting Parameters: HPDC Process Control
item.description: A parameter-level guide to HPDC process control: shot profile, gate velocity, fill time, intensification, die temperature, clamp force and process windows.

item.title: Low Pressure Die Casting: Process, Applications and Limits
item.description: Low pressure die casting explained: sealed furnace and riser tube mechanics, 0.02-0.1 MPa fill, wheel and cylinder head applications, yield and cycle limits.

item.title: Magnesium Die Casting: Alloys, Parameters and Design Rules
item.description: Magnesium die casting explained: AZ91D, AM60B and AS41B alloys, hot and cold chamber settings, cover gas control, thin wall limits and design rules.

item.title: Vacuum Assisted Die Casting: Reducing Gas Porosity
item.description: How vacuum assisted die casting works: valve types, evacuation timing, 50-150 mbar targets, high vacuum below 50 mbar and heat treatable castings.
